backend/main.mo: Defines the main canister with user profiles, time zones, habits, quotes, and access‑controlled queries and updates.
backend/migration.mo: Provides migration logic mapping old actor state to the new structure including time zones and renamed profile storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing frontend updates for time‑zone‑aware daily quotes and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend files covering layout, habit features, quotes, styling, and infrastructure.
frontend/index.css: Defines global CSS variables and theme tokens for light and dark modes using Tailwind layers.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app wiring QueryClient, header, daily quote banner, habit view, footer, and toasts.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthRequire: Alert component prompting unauthenticated users to sign in via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthStateIn: Displays signed‑in or not‑signed‑in status based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/Logout button handling Internet Identity auth flow with query cache reset on logout.
frontend/src/components/quotes/DailyMoti: Renders a daily quote, time‑zone prompt, skeleton state, or fallback message using the useDailyZenQuote hook.
frontend/src/components/quotes/TimeZoneI: UI component allowing users to select and save a timezone via backend actor, with validation and loading state.
frontend/src/features/becoming/api/queri: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating habits, handling actor availability, authentication, cache invalidation, and error normalization.
frontend/src/features/becoming/component: Main habits view coordinating auth checks, error states, loading skeletons, and rendering habit grid and summaries.
Displays a user-friendly error message with an optional retry button for failed habit loads.
Skeleton placeholder UI mimicking the habit grid layout while data loads.
Modal for editing a habit’s name, unit, and volume with validation and multiple update mutations.
Renders the monthly habit tracking grid with day headers and habit rows.
Defines layout constants and helpers for aligning habit grid columns.
Inline UI for creating new habits with input handling and add-habit mutation.
Renders a habit row with info, monthly volume, and daily completion checkboxes, supporting edits and toggling completion state.
Provides a popover around a child element offering an Edit Habit action.
Aggregates and displays total reps and time volume for all habits in the selected month.
Renders month tabs for 2026 and notifies when the selected month changes.
frontend/src/features/becoming/constants: Exports 2026 month metadata and helpers for retrieving month info and day counts.
frontend/src/features/becoming/state/hab: Builds habit completion maps and provides utilities for checking completion and computing displayable monthly volume data.
frontend/src/features/becoming/utils/tim: Contains utilities for validating, parsing, normalizing, and formatting time strings in M:SS or minutes formats.
frontend/src/features/quotes/hooks/useDa: Fetches the user's timezone and daily quote, parsing the quote and exposing loading and error state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithTimeout.t: Initializes a backend actor with a 15s timeout, handling authentication, secret admin token setup, error normalization, and manual retry support.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles and a light cyber-themed design system with custom colors, glass surfaces, and mobile touch optimizations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity provider contexts.
frontend/src/utils/icErrors.ts: Normalizes IC-related errors and detects stopped-canister scenarios, providing user-friendly error messages.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, and persisting URL parameters, including session-backed and hash-based parsing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and components using CSS variables and plugins.
project_state.json: Describes the project's state and requirements for deterministic daily quote rotation with persisted timezone and data migration needs.
